evidence1888.tests: held-out v2 paired campaign (campaign.mjs --acceptance-188.8) and per-arm delivery diagnostics (retrieval-diagnostics.mjs)
evidence1888.paidEvidence: docs/_evidence/memory-bench/188.8/acceptance-comparisons.json: post-fix fabric 47/100 vs pre-fix fabric 46/100 on held-out v2 (overall +0.01, 95% CI [-0.05,0.07], Holm p 1.0; no primary ability changed significantly). fabric-agentic 38/100, full context 79/100. Post-fix fabric is -0.32 against full (95% CI [-0.42,-0.23], p<1e-4), so the plan reports an opt-in improvement question and a substitution question separately; neither passes.
evidence1888.attribution: delivery is no longer the main loss: all-needed-visible rises (knowledge-update 1/20 -> 3/20, single-session-user 17/20 -> 19/20) and fine_selection_gap falls 18 -> 15, but answers do not move; answering/synthesis stays the largest bucket (answer_gap 26 of 53 failures), then fine selection 15, candidate gap 6, selection gap 3, one store error and two questions without usable gold.
evidence1888.remainingLimits: D6 multi-session aggregation stays unaddressed (4/20 post-fix; 15/20 full), and D7 preference has no held-out ids (development-only 5/20). One held-out question cannot be stored at all: a single round exceeds the core 64,384-character entry limit, which both fabric arms score wrong identically. The agentic arm hits the eight-turn limit on 18% of questions even with the default-kind discovery hint, so its 38/100 is a turn-budget result, not a retrieval result.

evidence1889.tests: held-out v2 paired campaign (campaign.mjs --acceptance-188.9) and a product-store delivery diagnostic (retrieval-diagnostics.mjs --store-from)
evidence1889.paidEvidence: docs/_evidence/memory-bench/188.9/acceptance/acceptance-comparisons.json: fabric-x 76/100 vs 188.8-pinned fabric 51/100 on held-out v2 (overall +0.25, 95% CI [0.16,0.34]; knowledge-update +0.5, Holm p 0.0078; the other three primary abilities positive but not significant after Holm). Full context is 79/100 and reused from 188.8, so fabric-x is -0.03 overall (95% CI [-0.12,0.06]): an improvement over the pinned baseline, not a full-context substitute.
evidence1889.attribution: delivery still decides most remaining failures on the exchange store: of 24 failures, partial_evidence 8, candidate_gap 5, fine_selection_gap 4 and synthesis (answer_gap) 5, with 2 questions without usable gold. Conditional accuracy is 63/68 (93%) when all needed evidence is visible and 13/30 (43%) when it is not, so the visible-evidence answerer is strong and the loss is in getting the evidence in.
evidence1889.remainingLimits: The baseline has no product-store snapshot (legacy direct ingest), so only the treatment arm has a stage table. `fabric-xc` was not run: its write side is unmeasured and half its measured sessions failed consolidation at the 4,096-token output cap. Multi-session (x-baseline +0.25, Holm p 0.19) and temporal-reasoning (+0.25, p 0.25) stay unproven, and abstention has no held-out ids.

evidence18810.tests: scripts/memory-bench/acceptance.test.mjs (held-out v3 manifest, Stage A selection, frozen product, pre-registered criteria, verdict); tools and partial-cue tests in package and harness suites
evidence18810.paidEvidence: docs/_evidence/memory-bench/188.10/acceptance/acceptance-comparisons.json: on held-out v3 (100 ids, first read here) fabric-x-tools scores 76/100 versus fabric-x 49/100 and full context 69/100. Multi-session 28/40 versus 10/40, paired +0.45 (95% CI 0.275..0.625, McNemar p=2e-4); knowledge-update +2, temporal-reasoning +5, single-session-user +1, single-session-assistant +1; overall +0.27 (CI 0.17..0.37). Against full context +0.07 (CI -0.03..0.17), inside the 3-point non-inferiority margin, so the selected configuration is a full-context substitute at 26% of its input tokens. Development screen moved multi-session 8/30 to 22/30 with no ability loss (docs/_evidence/memory-bench/188.10/screen-a/verdict.json).
evidence18810.attribution: The lever is agentic read access to the exchange store, not a wider injection: 152 tool calls and 100 recall calls over 100 questions, evidenceRoundCoverage 0.628 -> 0.834, evidenceAllRequired 52 -> 76, irrelevant injection 0.810 -> 0.777, cited-id rate 0.141 -> 0.202, conditional accuracy 44/52 -> 68/76 when all needed evidence is visible and 5/42 -> 8/19 when not. Passive injection alone stays at 49/100, so the passive block's partial evidence remains the residual gap when tools are hidden.
evidence18810.remainingLimits: No stage table exists for held-out v3: the multi-session diagnostic refuses the held-out draw by design and was not weakened after scoring. Preference and abstention have no fresh ids (development-only non-regression). The tools path costs 4.7x the passive arm's tokens (29,669 vs 6,378 per question) and 2% of questions hit the eight-turn limit. The measured configuration archives exchanges, so it stays opt-in: the quality rule is met but no safety or leakage verdict covers storing conversation content by default.
